result.title: DoC: Learning to Defer or Commit for Timely, Accurate, and Stable Conversational Diagnosis Prediction
result.summary: Conversational diagnosis prediction requires accurate, early, and stable predictions from ongoing clinical dialogue, yet dialogue-level labels do not specify when to commit. We propose a two-phase framework for learning deferral and diagnosis decisions. First, iterative commitment-boundary estimation constructs Defer/diagnosis supervision without annotated commitment times. Second, Defer-aware supervised fine-tuning initializes a policy, refined through reinforcement learning with trajectory-level rewards for timeliness, first-commit accuracy, and post-commit stability. On EMSDialog and MediTOD, DoC commits early, achieving the highest first-commit accuracy among post-trained methods (76.7%/51.2%) and the lowest post-commit error overall (16.4%/48.3%).

AI.brief_summary: 提出两阶段对话诊断预测框架：先用迭代式承诺边界估计自动构造 Defer/诊断监督，再以 Defer-aware SFT 初始化策略，并用面向及时性、首次承诺准确率与承诺后稳定性的轨迹级奖励进行强化学习。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「何时承诺或延迟」策略及轨迹级及时性、稳定性奖励，可能为 LVR 的 STOP 决策与提交后状态稳定性提供训练和评价线索；但无视觉或 latent 状态机制，迁移可行性需核查。
